[TPS_MANI_03327] Network Interface configuration for DoIP ⌈The DoIpNet- workConfigurationDesign contains all configuration settings that are specific for a configured network connection. The network connection is configured with the Plat- formModuleEthernetEndpointConfiguration that is referenced by the DoIp- NetworkConfigurationDesign in the role networkConfiguration. The tcpPort and udpPort references to the ApApplicationEndpoint are used to configure the T ransport Protocol (Udp or Tcp) and the used Port number. The IP Address is configured in the NetworkEndpoint that is referenced by the Platform- ModuleEthernetEndpointConfiguration via the EthernetCommunication- Connector.⌋
